code.title: Code
code.description: The single-letter (or short) code printed at the left of the entry inside this Part III box, verbatim uppercase as printed (e.g. 'A', 'C', 'AC'). Identifies the row: entries in a coded box are aligned by this code at eval time, not by position. Null only if an amount prints with no code.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: [no-anchor] The dollar amount printed beside the code in this box (the printed label anchor is the box header on the parent array, e.g. '15 Credits'). JSON number exactly as printed with any thousands comma removed; a loss/negative prints in parentheses or with a leading minus and is negative; null if a code prints with no amount. Some codes (e.g. box 16 foreign-transaction country lines) carry text rather than a number — null the amount when the entry value is non-numeric.

schema.title: Schedule K-1 (Form 1120S) Shareholder's Share of Income, Deductions, Credits, etc.

final_k1.title: Final K-1
final_k1.description: The 'Final K-1' checkbox at the top. TWO-STATE: true only if marked; false otherwise incl. blank. Never null.

amended_k1.title: Amended K-1
amended_k1.description: The 'Amended K-1' checkbox at the top. TWO-STATE: true only if marked; false otherwise incl. blank. Never null.

corporation_ein.title: Corporation EIN
corporation_ein.description: Item A 'Corporation's employer identification number', verbatim incl. hyphen, e.g. '26-3839121'.

corporation_name.title: Corporation name
corporation_name.description: The corporation name in item B 'Corporation's name, address, city, state, and ZIP code' (name line), verbatim, e.g. 'Pine Harbour Water Utilities LLC'.

corporation_address.title: Corporation address
corporation_address.description: The corporation mailing address in item B, below the name; join lines with ', ', e.g. 'P O BOX 447, Fruitland Park FL 34731'.

irs_center.title: IRS Center
irs_center.description: Item C 'IRS Center where corporation filed return', verbatim, e.g. 'Ogden, UT 84201'.

shareholder_id.title: Shareholder identifying number
shareholder_id.description: Item D 'Shareholder's identifying number' (SSN or EIN), verbatim incl. hyphens, e.g. '288-56-3387'.

shareholder_name.title: Shareholder name
shareholder_name.description: The shareholder name in item E 'Shareholder's name, address, city, state, and ZIP code' (name line), verbatim, e.g. 'Robert Stewart'.

shareholder_address.title: Shareholder address
shareholder_address.description: The shareholder mailing address in item E, below the name; join lines with ', ', e.g. 'P.O. Box 447, Fruitland Park FL 34731'.

shareholder_stock_ownership_pct.title: Shareholder stock ownership %
shareholder_stock_ownership_pct.description: Item F 'Shareholder's percentage of stock ownership for tax year'. JSON number of the printed percent, e.g. 33.3333; null if blank.

box_1_ordinary_business_income.title: Box 1 ordinary business income
box_1_ordinary_business_income.description: Part III box '1 Ordinary business income (loss)': the dollar amount printed in the box. JSON number exactly as printed, comma removed; a loss prints in parentheses or with a leading minus and is negative; null if blank.
